messages:
Maya S: Heads-up, EdgeHW support flagged missing entitlements for a subset of EU devices. Our ledger shows usage events, but entitlement joins are empty for ent_EDGE_* for the window 2026-03-21 22:00 -> 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC. Could be ingestion/heartbeat lag.
Ibrahim T: Noted. Quick hypothesis: partner timestamps in local TZ +1, we normalize to UTC, but our join key uses event_hour = trunc_to_hour(timestamp). If any rounding pushes to previous hour for some events we'll miss the hourly entitlement snapshot.
Jordan L: They also flipped to compressed batches last week (gzip). The batch-processor fallback path sets entitlement_id=null when parsing fails. @Ops Bot do we have parsing error counts from that window?
Ops Bot: Alert: 4321110015 - batch-processor failed msg=Invalid gzip footer for 12 events. Retries=3. Route=partner-ingest-eu.
EdgeHW Support: We're checking. We pushed a client update 3.3.0 that enabled gzip batching and heartbeat jitter. Example payload we sent (raw): ```json
{"device_id":"edge-9922","usage_units":48,"timestamp":"2026-03-21T23:59:59+01:00","entitlement_id":"ent_EDGE_42"}
```
Maya S: Thanks. If that timestamp is +01:00 then UTC=2026-03-21T22:59:59Z so the hour-bucket remains 22:00-23:00. DST not in effect then, so rounding shouldn't flip hour for this sample. But gzip parse errors could drop entitlement_id.
Ibrahim T: I'll pull ingest logs and run a quick query to count edgehw events where entitlement_id IS NULL for 2026-03-21 and list batch ids. Running: `SELECT batch_id, count(*) FROM ingest WHERE partner='edgehw' AND date='2026-03-21' AND entitlement_id IS NULL GROUP BY batch_id ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 20;`
Jordan L: I'll spin up a staging replay using the raw S3 batches into batch-processor v2.4 (stricter gzip handling) to see if we can reproduce. Replay id: rp-4321, scheduled 09:30 PT.
Maya S: Proposed actions: (1) Ibrahim to paste sample batch ids + example raw payloads here; (2) Jordan to run replay and report delta between original ledger and replayed ledger; (3) EdgeHW to share exact client version + changelog and any runtime error logs. We'll draft a partner note if we confirm impact. Marking P2 for now.
EdgeHW Support: Sharing changelog: client 3.2.1 -> 3.3.0: enabled gzip batch compression, switched to jittered heartbeat, increased batch size from 50->200. Attaching runtime logs (link): https://partners.edgehw/logs/edge_batch_20260321.tar.gz
Ops Bot: Created ticket TICKET-7891 - partner-ingest-edgehw-gzip-fallback (assignee: jordan.l).
Ibrahim T: Partial results: found 7 batch_ids with >100 events each where entitlement_id is null and gzip-error flagged in processor logs: batch-22341, batch-22342, batch-22410, batch-22411, batch-22500, batch-22501, batch-22512. Pasting one raw fetch (sanitized): `{"batch_id":"batch-22410","events":200,"gzip_ok":false}`
Jordan L: Replay rp-4321 completed. Initial compare: of 12,000 events replayed, 11,820 matched ledger after processing, 180 events had entitlement_id null on original ingest but were correctly parsed by v2.4 and joined to entitlements -> delta = 1.5% of that day's edgehw footprint.
Maya S: 1.5% is material. We need partner-facing communications and to stop invoicing that delta until we reconcile. @EdgeHW Support can you confirm whether those 180 events include billable usage (they look like non-zero usage_units)?
EdgeHW Support: Confirmed those 180 events all have usage_units > 0. We'll pause billing on our end for that batch window pending your reconciliation.
Maya S: Okay. Next steps: (A) Jordan to run full-day replay for 2026-03-21 into v2.4 and produce reconciled ledger diff; (B) Ibrahim to prepare a technical appendix listing batch ids and root cause (gzip footer/parse fallback); (C) I'll draft a partner note saying: summary, immediate mitigation (pause billing for implicated batches), timeline for fix (upgrade fallback path + force reprocess), and expected credit amount estimate.
Jordan L: Running full-day replay now (job rp-4322). ETA ~25m.
Ibrahim T: Draft appendix will include: root cause = batch-processor fallback when gzip parse fails sets entitlement_id=null; deployment mismatch (v2.4 fix) rolled to prod but some legacy processors still running in EU; suggestion = backfill reprocess and enforce strict parsing + metric to surface gzip_errors in near-real-time.
Maya S: Thanks all. If replay diff >0.5% we escalate to payments ops and open a formal credit memo. Keeping thread open until rp-4322 results are in. :memo:
